title: Share the group piece
objective: I can finish, look back at and share my part of the group piece.
success_criteria: I can use my Lesson 1 plan to share my part.
I can ask what the listener saw and try one change.
I can look back at and check our share again.

scheme_row.outcome_paraphrased: Share a creative contribution and respond to a comment.

lesson_sequence: Lesson 1 rehearses the component cues through a shared checkpoint. Lesson 2 recalls these cues, completes the sequence, shares and refines it.
layout_reference: Week 8 layout; accepted Week 3 paired edition
award_status: Practice evidence only. No completion decision, encounter, public event or completed response is pre-filled.
picture_colours: Picture colours. Navy is the dark header and frame. White is the card ground. Teal is the start triangle and check tick. Blue is the play dot. Amber is the art page and change arrow. Red is the stop square. Dark ink is used for words and box lines. Words, numbers and shapes give the meaning. Green · Ready, Amber · Help, Red · Pause.
marking_formula: in the same colour, on the same page or usual mode
